overview: A one-page State Department list-of-papers sheet for material concerning news-gathering agencies operating between Japan and Portugal. It indexes a message dated January 27, 1943, reporting that a Domei representative in Lisbon was gathering news for the benefit of the Japanese government and that the information was intended for the Minister and Secretary.

subfiles.title: List of papers on news-gathering agencies between Japan and Portugal
subfiles.about: An index sheet records a January 27, 1943 message about a Domei representative collecting news in Lisbon for the Japanese government.
subfiles.summary: The sheet lists one paper under the subject of news-gathering agencies between Japan and Portugal. The indexed message, dated January 27, 1943, concerns information from a source that a Domei representative in Lisbon was actively gathering news for the Japanese government. The message was designated for the Minister and Secretary.

interest: Although only an index sheet survives in this file unit, it points to Japanese wartime news-gathering activity in neutral Portugal and specifically identifies Lisbon as an operational center. It is useful as evidence of State Department monitoring of Domei's overseas activities and of the blurred boundary between journalism, propaganda, and intelligence during World War II. The OCR reading “Dental representative” is evidently a corruption of “Domei representative,” consistent with the file's press-agency subject.
